messages:
Maya (prod): Quick sync: define recruitment criteria + weekly feedback cadence for the Dedicated & Private dp. Target 8 partners, 6-8 week pilots. Inputs?
Noah (eng): We need to lock in model/quantization matrix per partner before onboarding. Some partners on A100 vs T4 will need different defaults.
Priya (solutions): For intake we should collect: primary use-case, compliance needs, infra type, point-of-contact, desired success metrics. I'll prototype a short form.
Jon (devex): Suggest a one-click "enable telemetry" toggle in the Console for dp partners so we can get token breakdowns. Also add an opt-in for anonymized logs.
Ava (research): Feedback plan: weekly short survey + automated evals; add a POOL for partner-submitted prompts. Mid-pilot demo + retrospective.
Maya (prod): Launch criteria brainstorm: uptime/stability, regression delta <=2% vs baseline, p95 latency under 400ms (pilot-relaxed), and partner satisfaction >=4/5. Thoughts?
Noah (eng): 400ms seems reasonable as pilot-relaxed. Capture both 300ms and 400ms so we can tighten later. Also need rollback policy defined.
Priya (solutions): Recruitment incentives: $3k service credit + 4 SE office hours + public case study credit. Would help with signups.
Jon (devex): Blocker: KMS onboarding varies. We should have a "KMS readiness" preflight checklist in the intake. I'll draft the checklist.
Maya (prod): Priority verticals: regulated finance, healthcare, and security platform teams. Ava, can you return 6 screening Qs by EOD?
Ava (research): Yep. Also adding a data residency checkbox and a simple perf test script partners can run.
calendar-bot: Kickoff scheduled Fri 9am PT and invite sent.
Maya (prod): I'll assemble a one-pager and post the intake form link after the kickoff. Thanks all :rocket:
